content: abetlen/llama-cpp-python README (primary): PyPI install builds llama.cpp from source; prebuilt wheel indexes under abetlen.github.io/llama-cpp-python/whl/{cpu,cu118..cu132,metal,rocm72,vulkan,hip-radeon}; CUDA and Metal wheels support Python 3.10-3.12 ONLY (no cp313); CMAKE_ARGS=-DGGML_METAL=on / -DGGML_CUDA=on for source builds; upgrade guidance --upgrade --force-reinstall --no-cache-dir (pip caches wheels by version, not CMAKE_ARGS, so a cached CPU wheel silently satisfies a Metal request); Windows needs Visual Studio or MinGW (w64devkit recipe).
